portfolio.no_transactions: No transactions yet — upload a Revolut CSV on the **Import** page.
portfolio.ledger_no_positions: Ledger has rows but no positions could be built. Check the Import preview.
portfolio.data_unavailable: Market data unavailable right now — switch tabs or reload to retry.
portfolio.realised_pl_help: All-time FIFO gains from closed sales, at transaction-date ECB rates. Per-year breakdown and tax on the Realized & tax tab.
portfolio.market_closed_note: Market closed — the day change shows the last completed session's move (dimmed until the market reopens).
portfolio.premarket_note: Pre-market — the day change is the pre-open move against the previous close.
portfolio.postmarket_note: After hours — the day change includes the post-close move.
portfolio.positions_caption: Live prices via yfinance, converted at the ECB spot rate. Today/week/month mark today's holdings at daily closes × daily ECB FX (fixed basket — buys/sells inside the window aren't flow-adjusted; per-ticker day change includes the FX move). n/a = price/FX unavailable.
portfolio.not_enough_history: Not enough data to build the history.
portfolio.hist_note_injected: Injected = cumulative buys (incl. fees) minus sale proceeds, at transaction-date ECB rates. Value = daily closes × ECB daily FX. Dividends excluded.
portfolio.hist_note_missing: No price history for: {tickers} — carried at cost.
portfolio.report_failed: Couldn't build the report — the price & profile download failed. Switch tabs or reload to retry.
portfolio.real_perf_note: From the ledger's daily value in your reporting currency: sold positions, dividends and FX included; deposits/withdrawals don't count as performance.
portfolio.twr_return_help: Geometric annualised time-weighted return (TWR) of your actual book over the window, in your reporting currency — sold positions and dividends included, your own deposits and withdrawals excluded.
portfolio.mwr_help: Annualised internal rate of return of your own cash flows over the window — how YOUR money did, so deposit/withdrawal timing matters. Differs from the TWR when you added or removed money at good/bad moments.
portfolio.twr_vol_help: Standard deviation of the book's actual daily TWR returns scaled to a year — how bumpy your ride really was.
portfolio.twr_dd_help: Worst peak-to-trough fall of the book's actual TWR path over the window — the most you were really down.
portfolio.basket_vol_help: Standard deviation of daily returns of today's holdings backtested at fixed weights in your reporting currency — a forward-looking risk read on the basket you hold now.
portfolio.basket_dd_help: Worst peak-to-trough fall of today's basket backtested over the window — a stress indicator for the current composition, NOT a loss you actually took.
portfolio.effective_names_help: Diversification (1/HHI): how many equal-size positions the book behaves like. 10 holdings concentrated in 2 big ones ≈ 3–4 effective names.
portfolio.top5_help: Share of the book's market value held in the 5 largest positions.
portfolio.basket_beta_caption: Beta vs benchmarks: {betas}. β > 1 amplifies the benchmark's moves, < 1 dampens them.
portfolio.alloc_broker_caption: Broker = where the shares are held, from each ledger row's import note; a holding split across brokers is split by share count. Tax figures stay FIFO across all brokers (art. 37 LIRPF).
portfolio.twr_note: Actual (TWR) = daily time-weighted return of the ledger book — flow-adjusted, so deposits/withdrawals don't count as performance; starts at your first transaction. Current basket = today's holdings backtested at fixed weights over the window.
portfolio.twr_note_missing: No usable price history for: {tickers} — carried at cost in the TWR.
portfolio.twr_note_skipped: Days excluded from the return: {days} — the cash moved but the value path didn't follow (an unrecorded split or corporate action).
portfolio.es_tax_caption: IRPF = Spanish personal income tax; capital gains and dividends fall in its *savings base*, taxed at progressive 19–28% brackets. FIFO: sales match your oldest shares first (art. 37 LIRPF).
portfolio.es_net_taxable_help: Realized gains minus deductible losses for the year (including 2-month-rule deferrals recovered when the replacement shares are sold), in EUR at each transaction date's ECB rate.
portfolio.es_estimated_tax_help: Savings-base brackets applied to the net taxable amount — ignores your other income and regional quirks.
portfolio.es_carryforward_loss_help: Net loss you can offset against gains in the next 4 years.
portfolio.es_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses (and recovered deferrals) stack down; the diamond is the net savings base that gets taxed.
portfolio.es_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. IRPF nets the savings base over the whole fiscal year, not month by month.
portfolio.es_flag_modelo_720: Modelo 720 (informative declaration of assets held abroad, 50.000 EUR line): {message}
portfolio.es_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — verify with your gestor / Renta.
portfolio.no_dividends: No dividends recorded. (Revolut dividends import as gross, 0 withholding.)
portfolio.dividends_caption: Creditable = Spanish double-tax credit (capped at 15% treaty rate). Withholding shows 0 unless you edited dividend fees — Revolut's CSV doesn't break it out.
portfolio.es_flag_modelo_720_reportable: foreign holdings ~{val} EUR ≥ 50.000 EUR: Modelo 720 may apply if held via a non-Spanish broker.
portfolio.no_fees: No trades in the ledger — nothing to analyse.
portfolio.fees_explicit_help: Trade commissions from the ledger plus standalone charges (custody, account), converted at the rate for each row's own date.
portfolio.fees_spread_help: Execution cost vs the session midpoint ((high+low)/2 of each trade's day): buys above mid and sells below mid cost money. A single trade is intraday noise; summed over the whole book, what remains is the broker's systematic spread/markup. Can be negative (you executed better than mid).
portfolio.fees_pct_volume_help: Fees plus estimated spread, as a % of executed volume (buys + sells).
portfolio.fees_spread_coverage: Spread estimated on {measured} of {total} trades — the rest have no daily bar on their date (holiday or symbol without history).
portfolio.fees_outside_range: Of that, {val} comes from executions outside the day's high–low range — definitely broker markup, not intraday noise.
portfolio.fees_caption: Broker = source of each import (ledger note). Revolut's CSV breaks out neither commissions nor the FX markup: its real costs show up mostly as spread. bps = basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Dividend withholding excluded — Dividends tab.
portfolio.tax_caption: Realized gains and losses for the year, lots matched FIFO (oldest first).
portfolio.us_tax_caption: US federal capital gains. Lots held more than a year are long-term (0/15/20% rates); the rest is short-term, taxed as ordinary income. FIFO matching — the broker default when you identify no lots. A loss is disallowed when you buy the same security back within 30 days, and comes back with those replacement shares.
portfolio.net_taxable_help: Realized gains minus deductible losses for the year, converted at each transaction date's official rate.
portfolio.us_net_taxable_help: Net capital gain after the short- and long-term buckets net against each other — USD at each transaction date's rate.
portfolio.estimated_tax_help: Your jurisdiction's brackets applied to the net taxable amount.
portfolio.us_estimated_tax_help: Federal only: ordinary rates on the net short-term gain (stacked on the other income you set in Profile), 0/15/20% on the net long-term gain, plus NIIT if you switched it on. No state tax, no AMT.
portfolio.carryforward_loss_help: Net loss you can offset against later gains.
portfolio.us_carryforward_loss_help: Net loss left after the $3,000 deduction against ordinary income ($1,500 filing separately) — carries forward indefinitely, keeping its short/long character.
portfolio.short_net_help: Gains less deductible losses on lots held a year or less — taxed at ordinary income rates.
portfolio.long_net_help: Gains less deductible losses on lots held more than a year — taxed at the preferential 0/15/20% rates.
portfolio.us_bracket_year_note: · rates are the {year} tables — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses (and restored losses) stack down; the diamond is the net that gets taxed.
portfolio.us_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses (and losses restored when replacement shares were sold) stack down; the diamond is the net capital gain.
portfolio.realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. Tax is settled over the whole year, not month by month.
portfolio.us_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. The short- and long-term buckets net over the whole tax year, not month by month.
portfolio.flag_default_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} ≥ {threshold} — a reporting duty may apply.
portfolio.us_flag_fbar_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: FBAR may apply if they sit in a foreign account — not if your broker is a US one.
portfolio.us_flag_form_8938_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: Form 8938 may apply — foreign stock held in a US brokerage account is outside it.
portfolio.planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — check it before you file.
portfolio.us_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — federal only, no state tax, and FIFO rather than any lot election. Check it with your CPA before filing.
portfolio.de_tax_caption: German Abgeltungsteuer: a flat 25% on capital income plus the 5.5% solidarity surcharge on that tax (26.375% all in), church tax on top where you pay it. FIFO matching, no wash-sale rule. Losses on shares may only offset gains on shares; fund and other losses offset capital income generally. 30% of an equity fund's result — gain or loss — is exempt.
portfolio.de_net_taxable_help: Capital income after the two loss circles net and the Sparer-Pauschbetrag comes off (€1,000, €2,000 filing jointly).
portfolio.de_estimated_tax_help: 25% Abgeltungsteuer plus the 5.5% solidarity surcharge on the tax, plus church tax at the rate set in Profile. Ignores the Günstigerprüfung against the progressive scale.
portfolio.de_carryforward_loss_help: Unused losses, carried forward indefinitely. The share and general circles carry forward separately — a share loss never becomes deductible against fund income.
portfolio.de_share_net_help: Gains less losses on individual shares (§20(6) EStG). A net loss here waits for a future share gain; it cannot touch fund or interest income.
portfolio.de_general_net_help: Funds, certificates and everything else, after the 30% partial exemption. A net loss here does offset share gains.
portfolio.de_funds_unclassified_note: · no fund classification yet, so the 30% Teilfreistellung is not applied — open the Ticker page for your funds once and it is learned
portfolio.de_share_loss_note: · €{carry} of share losses carried forward, deductible only against share gains
portfolio.de_church_note: · includes church tax at {rate}% of the tax
portfolio.de_vorabpauschale_note: · the Vorabpauschale on accumulating funds is not modelled (it needs each fund's year-end NAV and the Basiszins)
portfolio.de_flag_anlage_kap_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} — a foreign broker withholds no Abgeltungsteuer, so this income has to be declared (KAP-INV for funds).
portfolio.de_flag_anlage_kap_ok: nothing held abroad — a German broker withholds at source.
portfolio.de_flag_awv_reportable: foreign securities ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: monthly statistical reporting to the Bundesbank may apply.
portfolio.de_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no Vorabpauschale, no Günstigerprüfung, no church-tax edge cases. Check it with your Steuerberater before filing.
portfolio.de_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses stack down; the diamond is the capital income the flat rate taxes, before the Sparer-Pauschbetrag.
portfolio.de_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. The loss circles and the allowance settle over the whole year, not month by month.
portfolio.uk_tax_caption: UK CGT on shares: 18% inside what's left of your basic-rate band, 24% above it, after the £3,000 Annual Exempt Amount. The tax year runs 6 April to 5 April. Shares are identified same-day first, then any bought in the 30 days after a disposal, then the Section 104 pool at its average cost — which is why a cost here can differ from the lot you thought you sold.
portfolio.uk_net_taxable_help: Gains less this year's losses and the Annual Exempt Amount. Losses come off before the allowance, so a loss-making year can waste it.
portfolio.uk_estimated_tax_help: 18% on the part of the gain that fits in your remaining basic-rate band, 24% above it, using the other taxable income you set in Profile. Rates are the ones from 30 October 2024.
portfolio.uk_allowance_help: Annual Exempt Amount actually used this year (£3,000 for 2024/25 and 2025/26). It cannot be carried forward — unused, it is simply gone.
portfolio.uk_carryforward_loss_help: Net loss to carry forward, indefinitely, once claimed to HMRC. Brought-forward losses may only reduce a later year's gains down to the allowance, which this figure does not apply for you.
portfolio.uk_wasted_allowance_note: · £{wasted} of the allowance wasted (losses come off first)
portfolio.uk_proceeds_test_note: · disposal proceeds £{proceeds} exceed £50,000, so a return is due even with no gain
portfolio.uk_carryforward_note: · claim the loss with HMRC to carry it forward — an unclaimed loss expires after four years
portfolio.uk_straddle_note: · 2024/25 straddled the 30 October 2024 rate change; the whole year is priced at the post-Budget 18/24%
portfolio.uk_rate_year_note: · rates and allowance are the {year}/26 figures — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.uk_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no ISA or SIPP wrappers, no personal-allowance taper, no relief claims. Check it before you file.
portfolio.uk_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the net gain the allowance then comes off. Years run 6 April to 5 April.
portfolio.uk_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. Losses and the allowance settle over the whole tax year, not month by month.
